inspector.title: Focal cortical dysplasia: native FLAIR and source lesion annotation
inspector.modality: FLAIR MRI, separate T1 MRI and source lesion boundary
inspector.caption: Inspect native FLAIR and its source lesion annotation from one presurgical epilepsy research participant. Source metadata reports left-frontal FCD IIb and MRI suspicion; Primer does not infer diagnosis from appearance. T1 remains a separate source grid with unverified registration. All native planes and lesion-cell faces are retained. This example does not establish complete epilepsy reporting coverage.

An open presurgery MRI dataset of people with epilepsy and focal cortical dysplasia type II
